To: [Kentucky Medicaid health plan appeals department]  
Via: [Appeal submission address, fax, or online portal]

Re: Appeal of adverse benefit determination  
Member: Harper Alvarez  
Member ID: W597643658  
Reference number: POC-5ED3BAB6CA-81537  
Requested service: Lumbar decompression/disc surgery  
CPT: 63030  
Date of denial notice: August 6, 2026

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I appeal the denial of authorization for CPT 63030, lumbar decompression/disc surgery, requested by Duval, MD. The denial states that the submitted clinical records did not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment. The records do document extensive conservative treatment, persistent disabling symptoms, objective neurologic findings, and imaging-confirmed nerve-root compression.

The conservative-treatment requirement is addressed as follows:

- Harper has had 24 months of progressive lower-back pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- Harper completed 10 weeks of supervised physical therapy, including core stabilization and lumbar-flexibility treatment, from April 24, 2026, through July 3, 2026. The patient completed 16 visits, as documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- Harper used NSAIDs for eight months with inadequate relief.
- Harper received a corticosteroid injection on April 21, 2026. It provided only four weeks of partial relief.
- Despite these treatments, Harper continues to have radicular pain extending into the right calf and cannot stand for more than 10 minutes.

The medical findings support the requested procedure:

- A lumbar MRI dated June 24, 2026, shows an L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral-recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root.
- The physical examination documents positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level.
- The clinical symptoms, examination findings, and MRI abnormality are anatomically and neurologically concordant.

Harper has therefore undergone prolonged medication treatment, supervised physical therapy, and injection treatment without adequate or durable relief. The condition remains functionally limiting and includes objective nerve-root compression and a corresponding neurologic deficit. The submitted records directly address the stated reason for denial.

Please overturn the denial and authorize CPT 63030. If the request remains denied, please provide the complete medical-necessity policy and clinical-review criteria actually applied to this request, including the policy title, policy number, version or effective date, the specific criteria relied upon, and the clinical-review rationale. The governing policy has not been publicly identified or retrieved from the information available in the denial notice, so the plan has not been quoted in this appeal.

Please also provide written confirmation that this appeal was received and identify any additional information needed for review. If the plan cannot grant the requested authorization, please issue a written appeal determination with the applicable further-review and fair-hearing instructions.

Sincerely,

Harper Alvarez  
Member ID: W597643658
